title: During an earthquake — Drop, Cover, Hold On
text:
1. DROP to your hands and knees before the shaking knocks you down.
2. COVER your head and neck under a sturdy table or desk. If none, crouch against an interior wall away from windows.
3. HOLD ON to your shelter until the shaking stops; be ready to move with it.
4. Stay away from windows, glass, mirrors, and heavy objects that can fall.
5. If in bed, stay and cover your head with a pillow. If outdoors, move to an open area away from buildings, trees, and power lines.

title: Habang may lindol — Duck, Cover, Hold
text:
1. LUMUHOD (Duck) sa iyong mga kamay at tuhod bago ka matumba ng pagyanig.
2. MAGTAGO (Cover) ng ulo at leeg sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa. Kung wala, yumuko sa tabi ng panloob na pader na malayo sa bintana.
3. KUMAPIT (Hold) sa iyong takip hanggang tumigil ang pagyanig; maging handang gumalaw kasama nito.
4. Lumayo sa bintana, salamin, at mabibigat na bagay na maaaring mahulog.
5. Kung nasa kama, manatili at takpan ang ulo ng unan. Kung nasa labas, pumunta sa bukas na lugar na malayo sa gusali, puno, at linya ng kuryente.

title: After the shaking stops
text:
1. Check yourself and others for injuries. Give first aid before moving anyone seriously hurt.
2. Expect aftershocks. Move carefully to a safe open area away from damaged buildings.
3. Wear shoes to protect feet from broken glass and debris.
4. Check for gas leaks, fires, and damaged wiring. Do not use open flames or light switches until you are sure it is safe.
5. Use the stairs, never the elevator. Help neighbors, elderly, and PWDs evacuate.

title: Pagkatapos tumigil ang pagyanig
text:
1. Tingnan ang sarili at iba kung may sugat. Magbigay ng first aid bago igalaw ang malubhang nasaktan.
2. Asahan ang aftershocks. Gumalaw nang maingat papunta sa ligtas na bukas na lugar na malayo sa sirang gusali.
3. Magsuot ng sapatos para protektahan ang paa mula sa basag na salamin at kalat.
4. Tingnan kung may tumatagas na gas, apoy, at sirang kable. Huwag gumamit ng apoy o switch ng ilaw hanggang sigurado kang ligtas.
5. Gamitin ang hagdan, huwag ang elevator. Tulungan ang kapitbahay, matanda, at PWD na lumikas.

title: Suspected gas leak after an earthquake
text:
1. If you smell gas or hear hissing, do NOT light matches, use lighters, or flip any electrical switch — a spark can ignite it.
2. Open doors and windows to let gas escape.
3. Shut off the LPG tank valve or main gas supply if you can reach it safely.
4. Leave the building immediately and keep others away.
5. Do not re-enter until the area is confirmed safe. Report the leak to authorities when possible.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection / NDRRMC Safety Advisory

title: Pinaghihinalaang tumatagas na gas pagkatapos ng lindol
text:
1. Kung may amoy gas o naririnig na sumisirit, HUWAG magsindi ng posporo, lighter, o pindutin ang anumang switch ng kuryente — kayang magpaapoy ng kislap.
2. Buksan ang mga pinto at bintana para makalabas ang gas.
3. Isara ang balbula ng tangke ng LPG o pangunahing supply ng gas kung ligtas mong maaabot.
4. Lumabas agad sa gusali at ilayo ang iba.
5. Huwag bumalik hanggang kumpirmadong ligtas. Iulat ang pagtagas sa awtoridad kapag kaya na.
source: Bureau of Fire Protection / NDRRMC Safety Advisory

title: If you are trapped under debris
text:
1. Stay as calm as possible to save oxygen and energy.
2. Cover your mouth and nose with cloth to avoid breathing dust.
3. Do NOT shout unless you hear rescuers — shouting wastes energy and inhales dust.
4. Tap on a pipe or wall in a steady rhythm, or use a whistle, so rescuers can locate you by sound.
5. Avoid sudden movements that could cause more debris to fall. Conserve your phone battery; send one clear text if there is signal.
source: PHIVOLCS / NDRRMC Search and Rescue Guidance

title: Kung ikaw ay naiipit sa ilalim ng guho
text:
1. Manatiling kalmado hangga't kaya para makatipid ng oxygen at lakas.
2. Takpan ang bibig at ilong ng tela para hindi malanghap ang alikabok.
3. HUWAG sumigaw maliban kung may naririnig kang tagasagip — nauubos ng sigaw ang lakas at nakakalanghap ng alikabok.
4. Kumatok sa tubo o pader nang pantay na ritmo, o gumamit ng pito, para mahanap ka ng rescuer sa tunog.
5. Iwasan ang biglaang paggalaw na maaaring magpabagsak ng dagdag na guho. Tipirin ang baterya ng cellphone; magpadala ng isang malinaw na text kung may signal.
source: PHIVOLCS / NDRRMC Search and Rescue Guidance
